description: Read the FAA snapshot's informational medical class, medical dates, and BasicMed dates for one airman Unique ID. These fields are not authoritative medical certification or fitness determinations. Get the ID from faa_airmen_verify_certificate. Every call is rejected while the operator's personal-data redaction is on (the default).

uniqueId.description: Opaque FAA Unique ID from faa_airmen_verify_certificate, A or C plus seven digits, for example A9999999; not a certificate number.

name: faa_airmen_check_medical_status

airman.description: Matched person, absent for a missing ID.

city.description: Source city; present only with operator-enabled location access and personal-data redaction off.

firstName.description: Complete source FIRST NAME, including middle names.

identityVariants.description: All differing safe BASIC and certificate identities.

city.description: Source city; present only with operator-enabled location access and personal-data redaction off.

appliedFilters.description: Every effective normalized selector, filter, and paging value.

disclaimer.description: Medical information limitations, present on every result.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `pii_redacted`: Personal-data redaction is on; every medical call that passes the input schema is rejected before the ID is checked or the mirror is read. `invalid_identity`: Invalid or blank semantic identity selector. `mirror_missing`: No complete published mirror generation is available. `mirror_unavailable`: Published generation is corrupt, missing, incompatible, or unreadable. `mirror_rebuild_required`: Location access is enabled but this generation discarded city and ZIP. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Whether this Unique ID occurs in the releasable snapshot.

hasReportedMedicalFields.description: Whether any medical fields were reported; absent for a missing person, never an adverse finding.

medicalRecords.description: All distinct reported medical records; empty when a known person has no reported medical fields.

items.description: One distinct set of informational medical source fields.

basicMedCmecDateRaw.description: Raw BasicMed examination checklist date, normally YYYYMMDD.

basicMedCourseDateRaw.description: Raw BasicMed course date, normally YYYYMMDD.

medicalClass.description: Reported medical class; no fitness or eligibility verdict.

code.description: Verbatim source code; unknown values remain usable.

description.description: FAA documented meaning, absent for unknown codes.

medicalDateRaw.description: Raw source medical date, normally MMYYYY; malformed nonblank values retained.

medicalExpireDateRaw.description: Raw source medical expiry date, normally MMYYYY; not an eligibility determination.

sourceFamilies.description: Source families contributing these medical fields.

notice.description: Snapshot limitations, absence guidance, source-quality notices for the returned records, and operational notices; may be empty.

piiRedacted.description: Operator personal-data redaction: true withholds city, ZIP, and medical fields and limits searches to a full name or Unique ID.

anyOf.description: Per-call source provenance; topic mirror_status returns the full record.

ageBasis.description: Publication timestamp or conservative first-of-month age basis.

ageDays.description: Source age in days, independent of import time.

includeLocation.description: Generation import policy: city and ZIP kept at import, not what this response returns.

snapshotMonth.description: Advertised publication month in YYYY-MM format, not an exact effective date.

stale.description: Source exceeds the configured age threshold; not a credential judgment.

staleAfterDays.description: Configured source-age warning threshold in days.

provenance.description: Snapshot provenance, or null for static reference topics.
